अवन a. [अव्-ल्युट्] Protecting,
defending; अनवनी नवनीपवनावलिः
Śi. 6. 37.
--नं Protection &c.

अव ind. (the initial अ is
sometimes dropped, as in पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी
वगाह्य

अवंशः A bad family, wrong
family; ˚पतितो राजा

]
1 Downwards; backwards.
--2 Opposite, contrary.
--टं
Contrariety, opposition.

अवकर्षणं Drawing with strength,
removing a thing from one place to
another.

1 Taking or pulling out,
extraction.
--2 Expulsion.

अवकलित a.
1 Seen, observed.
--2 Known.
--3 Taken, received.
--4
Wicked, perverse.

अवका A grassy plant(शैवाल)
growing in marshy land.
--Comp.
--अद a. eating moss.
--उल्ब a.
covered or surrounded with अवका plants.

अवकाश् {c1c} {c4c} A. To be visible,
to be manifest. --Caus. To cause to
look at.

1 Occasion,
opportunity; ताते चापद्वितीये वहति
रणधुरां को भयस्यावकाशः

; oft. used with लभ् in the
sense of ‘to get an opportunity or
scope for action’; लब्धावकाशोऽ
विध्यन्मां तत्र दग्धो मनोभवः

.
--2 (a)
Place, space, room; अवकाशं
किलोदन्वान्रामायाभ्यर्थितो ददौ

your
unfinished sentence shows that
there is room to find fault. (b)
Footing, admission, scope,
access, entrance; (छाया) शुद्धे तु
दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Ś. 7. 32; oft. used
in these senses with लभ्;
लब्धावकाशा मे प्रार्थना, लब्धावकाशो मे मनोरथः
Ś. 1; शोकावेगदूषिते मे मनसि विवेक एव
नावकाशं लभते Prab.; also with कृ or
दा ‘to make room for’, ‘admit’, ‘give
way to’; असौ हि दत्वा तिमिरावकाशं

; अवकाशं
[]
रुध् to obstruct, hinder or impede;
नयनसलिलोत्पीडरुद्धावकाशां (निद्रां)

.
--3 Interval, intermediate space
or time.
--4 An aperture, opening.
--5
A glance cast on anything.
--6 N. of
certain verses during the recitation
of which the eyes must be fixed
upon certain objects.

अवकाश्य a. Admitted in the
recitation of the Avakāśa verses.

अवकीर्ण p. p.
1 Scattered, filled,
covered over; किमपौति
रजोभिरौर्वरैरवकीर्णस्य मणेर्महार्घता Śi. 16. 27.
--2
Coarsely pounded.
--3 Destroyed.
--4 Violated (as the vow of a ब्रह्मचारी),
degraded.

अवकीर्णिन् a. [अवकीर्णमनेन इष्टा˚ इनि]
Violating the vow or engagements
of continence. --m.
--(र्णी) A
religious student who has committed
an act of incontinence (such as
sexual intercourse) against his vow
of celibacy; अवकीर्णी भवेद्गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी तु
योषितम् । गर्दभं पशुमालभ्य नैरृतं स विशुध्यति ॥

-9; ˚व्रतं
penance for an act of incontinence.

1 Bending, curving,
contraction.
--2 A kind of disease.

अवकुटार a. [अव-स्वार्थे अतिशये वा
कुटारच्] Very deep, downwards,
backwards.
--रं Deformity. See अवकट.

अवकुट्टित a.
1 Vexed, inflamed.
--2 Cut off.

अवकुत्स् {c10c} U. To blame, revile,
contemn.

अवकुत्सित p. p. Blamed, reviled
&c.
--तं Blame, censure.

अवकृत् {c6c} P. To cut off or away.
--Caus. To cause to cut off.

अवकर्तः A part cut off, a strip;
वस्त्रावकर्तेन संवीता

अवकर्तिन् a. Cutting off or out;
चर्म˚

To draw off or
away, to pull off, drag down or pull
down.
--2 To extract, take out.

अवकृष्ट p. p.
1 Drawn away or
down, pulled down.
--2 Removed.
--3 Expelled, turned out or away.
--4 Inferior, low, degraded,
outcast (opp. उत्कृष्ट or प्रकृष्ट); ˚जातिः

; प्रतिकर्तुं प्रकृष्टस्य नावकृष्टेन
युज्यते Rām.
--ष्टः A servant who
performs the lowest menial duties
(such as sweeping &c.) (
संमार्जनशोधनविनियुक्त); पणो देयोऽवकृष्टस्य
षडुत्कृष्टस्य वेतनं

To bestow, pour
upon, to shower upon, cover with,
fill; Śi. 11. 62; (तं) अवाकिरन्
बाललताः प्रसूनैः

.
--3 To shake off, throw
off, leave.
--4 (Atm.) (Used
reflexively) (a) To extend, spread itself;
अवकिरते हस्ती स्वयमेव Sk. (b) To fall
asunder. (c) To pass away, fall off.
(d) To become faithless or untrue.

अवाकॄ {c6c} P. To strew, pour upon;
sprinkle with.

To correspond
with, to answer.
--2 To be right or fit,
to be possible; इतश्च न प्रधानस्य
प्रवृत्तिरवकल्पते Ś. B.
--3 To help to, to serve,
to accomplish, result in (with dat.);
शरीरिणां संसृतयेऽवकल्पते Bhāg. --

To put in order, to prepare; to
make ready; संभारानवकल्पय Mb.
--2 To
use or employ becomingly.
--3 To
consider as possible;
नावकल्प्यमिदंग्लायेद्यत्कृच्छ्रेषु भवानपि

अवकल्पित p. p. Corresponding
with; right, fit.

अवकॢप्तिः f.
1 Considering as
possible, possibility, probability;
क्वेव भोक्ष्येस अनवकॢप्तावेव Sk. (
अनवकॢप्तिरसंभावना).
--2 Suitableness.

अवकेश a. Having the hair
hanging down.

अवकेशिन् a.
1 Unfruitful, barren
(as a tree).
--2 [अवसन्नाः केशा विद्यंते
अस्य इनि] Having small or very
few hair. --m. A fruitless tree.

अवकोकिल a. [अवक्रुष्टः कोकिलया]
Drawn or called down to by a
cuckoo.

अवक्तव्य a.
1 Not fit to be
uttered, improper.
--2 Censurable (as a
saying).
--3 False.
--4 Indescribable,
inexpressible.

अवक्त्र a. Having no opening (as
a vessel, wound &c.).

अवक्र a. Not crooked, straight;
(fig.) honest, upright.

अवक्रक्षिन् [अव-कृष् णिनि पृ˚]
Dashing down, overcoming; अवक्रक्षिणं
वृषभं यथा जुरम्
अवक्रंद् {c1c} U. To cry out, roar.

अवक्रंद a. Crying slowly, roaring,
neighing.
--दः A cry.

To step
down or away, run away, escape,
withdraw.
--2 To tread down,
overcome; वज्रेणैवेनमवक्रामति Śat. Br.
--3 To descend, come down. --Caus.
To cause to go down.

अवक्रामिन् a. Ved. Running away,
escaping.

अवक्रिया Neglect, omission,
nonperformance of prescribed acts.

To purchase.
--2
To let out, hire.
--3 To bribe, buy off.

1 Price.
--2 Wages, hire,
farm, rent.
--3 Letting out to hire,
leasing;

.
--4 A tax or tribute
(to be paid to the king), duty (
राजग्राह्यं द्रव्यं Sk.).

अवक्रुश् {c1c} P. To call down to;
to revile.

अवक्रुष्ट p. p. Sounded ill or badly,
reviled, censured.

1 Discordant noise.
--2 A
curse.
--3 Abuse, censure.

अवक्लेदनं Trickling, falling (as dew
or moisture).

अवक्षामः Ved. Propitiatory
offering; satisfaction of claims,
compensation.

अवक्षि {c1c} {c5c} {c9c} P. To remove,
carry off, destroy. --Pass. To waste
away, decay.

1 Destruction, decay,
waste, loss; लब्धं रक्षेदवक्षयात्

अवक्षयणं Means of extinguishing
(fire &c.); as in अंगार˚.

अवक्षीण p. p. Wasted, emaciated.
--णं Loss, destruction.

To fling away,
to throw or cast off;
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रमवक्षिप्य मुनिवस्त्राण्यवस्त ह Rām.; to
hurl.
--2 To cause to fly down or
away.
--3 To reprimand, revile any
one, censure, slander;
मदलेखामवक्षिप्य

; अवाक्षिपद्वासुदेवं Mb.
--4 To
grant, yield. --Caus. To cause to
fall down.

अवक्षिप्त p. p.
1 Thrown down;
badly thrown.
--2 Said sarcastically,
imputed, insinuated.
--3 Reviled,
censured, blamed.

1 Throwing down,
considered as one of the five kinds of
karman, q. v.
--2 Contempt,
despising; अवक्षेपणे कन्

अवक्षुत p. p. Sneezed upon;
द्विषदन्नं नगर्यन्नं पतितान्नमवक्षुतं

To cut down,
break into pieces.
--2 To waste away,
wear away; अर्धयाममात्रावखंडितायां
विभावर्यां

when the night had
advanced only half a watch.
--3 To
destroy, annihilate.

अवखादः [अवज्ञातः निंदितः खादः खाद्यं]
Bad or contemptible meal; an
unworthy oblation.

1 Disobedience,
disrespect, contempt, disregard.
--2
Censure, blame.
--3 Insult, mortification.
--4 Defeat.

अवगण a. Separated from one's
companions, isolated, solitary, alone.

अवगंडः A boil or pimple upon
the face or cheeks.

To go down,
descend; अंजः समुद्रमवजग्मुरापः

.
--2 To come to, visit, go near.
--3 To reach, obtain.
--4 (a) To
know, learn, understand, think,
believe; कृतापराधमिवावगच्छति आत्मानं

; न खल्ववगच्छामि,
परस्तादवगम्यत एव Ś. 1; तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम
तेजोंशसंभवं

. (b) To consider, regard, look
upon.
--5 To assure oneself, be
convinced. --

To bring near.
--2
To inform oneself of, find out, know;
तावदेतेभ्यः प्रियाप्रवृत्तिरवगमयितव्या

.
--3 To inform, cause to know,
teach; पुरुषविशेषमवगमयति

;
सर्वमिदं पित्रोरवगमय्य Dk.
--4 To
indicate, show; संनाहोयं
साहसमवगमयति

अवगत p. p.
1 Gone away or
down.
--2 Known, learnt,
understood; sometimes used actively;
तदैव ध्यानादवगतोस्मि Ś. 7 I learnt;
ऊढपूर्वां तद्दुहितरमवगतोहं ibid. came to
know.
--3 Assented, promised.

अवगतिः f.
1 Knowledge,
perception, comprehension.
--2 True or
determinate knowledge; ब्रह्मावगतिर्हि
पुरुषार्थः; ब्रह्मावगतिस्त्वप्रतिज्ञाता Ś. B.

अवगमः --गमनं
1 Going near,
descending.
--2 Understanding,
comprehension, perception, knowledge,
being acquainted with.
--3 True or
determinate knowledge;
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्

अवगमः --गमनं
1 Going near,
descending.
--2 Understanding,
comprehension, perception, knowledge,
being acquainted with.
--3 True or
determinate knowledge;
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्

अवगादः A small wooden basin
for baling water out of a boat.

(a) To bathe
oneself in, plunge into, dive into;
with acc. or loc.; तमोपहंत्रीं तमसां
वगाह्य

.
(b) To go deep into, be
absorbed into (fig.);
अमात्यराक्षसेनाप्यनवगाहितयार्यचाणक्यस्य
चरितमवगाहितुमिच्छसि

.
--2 To enter,
penetrate, fully pervade;
विमानशृंगाण्यवगाहमानः (घोषः)

; see अवगाढ also.
--Caus. To bathe, cause to bathe.

अवगाढ p. p.
1 Plunged into,
entered into, immersed; जलावगाढस्य
वनद्विपस्य

; अमृतथदमिवावगाढोस्मि
Ś. 7; अवगाढः शोकसागरं Rām.;
समुद्रमवगाढानि पत्तनानि Rām.
--2
Depressed, low, deep (lit. and fig.);
अभ्युन्नता पुरस्तादवगाढा जघनगौरवात्पश्चात्
Ś. 3. 8; मन्युरभजदवगाढतरः Śi. 15. 2.
--3 That in which one bathes;
अवगाढा च पीता च (गंगा) पुनात्यासप्तमं
कुलं Mb.
--4 Congealed, curdling (as
blood).

.
--2 Plunging,
immersing (in general);
entering into; हुतभुगवगाहनसाहसिकां

.
--4 A place of
bathing.
--5 A bucket.

.
--4 A place of
bathing.
--5 A bucket.

अवगाह्य pot. p.
1 Fit for bathing.
--2 Fit to be plunged into.

अवगुणः A fault, defect,
demerit; अन्यदोषं परावगुणं Malli. on

; Śi. 5. 17.
--3 A covering,
mantle (in general).
--4 A
sweeping broom.
--Comp.
--मुद्रा [
अवगुंठनाय मुद्रा] a sort of religious
ceremony; सव्यहस्तकृता मुष्टिर्दीर्घाधोमुखतर्जनी ।
अवगुंठनमुद्रेयमभितो भ्रमिता मता ॥

अवगुंठनवत् a. Covered with a veil,
veiled; ˚वती नारी Ś. 5.

1 Veiling, hiding.
covering.
--2 A veil.
--3 A curtain.

अवगुंठित p. p.
1 Veiled, covered,
concealed; रजनीतिमिरावगुंठिते

enveloped in nocturnal
darkness.
--2 Powdered, pounded.

अवगुर् {c6c} U. To assail with
threats, to attack, to raise a weapon
for the purpose of striking a blow
(with loc. or dat.); न कदाचिद् द्विजे
तस्माद्विद्वानवगुरेदपि

अवगुरणं-गोरणं Menacing,
assaulting with intent to kill, assailing
with weapons.

अवगुरणं-गोरणं Menacing,
assaulting with intent to kill, assailing
with weapons.

To cover, to hide,
conceal; (रविः) पांशुपुंजावगूढः Mb.
--2
To put into or inside; उष्णीषं संवेष्ट्य
निवीतेऽवगूहते Kāty.
--3 To embrace; या
ममोद्विजते नित्यं सा मामद्यावगूहते

To sing in a
discorddant tone.
--2 To sing deprecatingly,
satirize in a song, revile, reproach
(mostly used in p. p.).

अवगीत p. p.
1 Sung in a
discordant tone, sung badly
--2 Reproached,
abused, censured; अनवगीतः परिचयः

; सोढावगीतप्रथमायुधस्य 17. 28;
Śi. 11. 10.
--3 Wicked, vile.
--4
Satirized in a song.
--5 Seen frequently,
well-known (मुहुर्दृष्ट).
--तं
1 A satire in
song, derision.
--2 Reproach, blame.
--3 Bad or discordant singing.

To let loose, let
go (as reins).
--2 To divide, separate
(as words or parts of words);
पितृपाणमित्यत्र हि पितृ पाणमित्यृकारोऽवगृह्यते

Com.
--3 To break off,
discontinue; to distinguish,
discriminate, discern.
--4 To punish, chastise;
मंदोपि नाम न महानवगृह्य साध्यः Śi. 5. 49.
--5 To seize, choke;
गद्गदिकावगृह्यमाणकंठा

.
--6 To capture, take
in possession, overpower;
स्वामिनमवशमवगृह्णंति

.
--7 To oppose, resist, hinder,
obstruct.
--8 To lay hold of (with the
feet). --Caus. To knead, make
dough.

अवगृहीत p. p. Obstructed,
impeded, restrained.

अवगृह्य a. Separable.
--ह्यं A pada
having the name प्रगृह्य.

1 Separation of the
component parts of a compound, or of
other grammatical forms.
--2 The
mark or interval of such a
[]
separation; समासेऽवग्रहो थस्वसमकालः.
--3 The
syllable or letter after which such
separation occurs; ऋदवग्रहात्

.
--4 A hiatus, absence of sandhi
(as in धिक् तां च तं च मदनं च इमां च मां
च instead of चेमांच)

.
--5
The mark (') used to mark the
elision of अ after ए and ओ.
--6
Withholding of rain, drought, failure of
rain; वृष्टिर्भवति शस्यानामवग्रहविशोषिणां

; रावणावग्रहक्लांतमिति वागमृतेन
सः 10. 48; नभोनभस्ययोर्वृष्टिमवग्रह
इवांतरे 12. 29; वृषेव सीतां तदवग्रहक्षतां

.
--7 An obstacle,
impediment, hindrance, restraint; संसार˚

the bonds or fetters of
worldly existence; प्रसह्य
रक्षोभिरवग्रहं च Rām.; see अनवग्रह and निरवग्रह.
--8 A herd of elephants.
--9 The
forehead of an elephant.
--10 Nature,
original temperament.
--11 A sort
of knowledge, a false idea.
--12
Punishment (opp. अनुग्रह);
अनुग्रहावग्रहयोर्विधाता Śi. 1. 71.
--13 An
imprecation, a term of abuse.
--14 An
iron hook with which elephants
are driven.

1 Breaking, separation.
--2 Impediment; अवग्राहस्ते भूयात् Sk.
--3 A curse; see अवग्रह.

1 An obstacle,
impediment.
--2 Disrespect, disregard.
--3
Knowledge.

To push or brush
away or off.
--2 To split, break or
cut asunder; पंचबाणान् अवघट्टयंती

.
--3 To touch, feel, rub;
जलौकोव्रणान्मधुनाऽवघट्टयेत् Suśr.
--4
To stir up, agitate.

1 A hole in the ground,
a cave, a cavern.
--2 A grindstone,
stone-mill for grinding corn.
--3
Stirring up, shaking.

To proclaim aloud.
--2 To send for, summon, convoke;
as a conclave (समाज).
--3 To fill
with cries, make resonant; नदीषु
कौंचावघुष्टासु Mb.

अवघूर्ण् {c1c} U. To whirl round,
brandish, move to and fro; as in
अवघूर्णमानताम्रदृष्टिः; वने यथा शाल
इवावघूर्णितः Mb. rocked to and fro.

अवघृष् {c1c} U. To rub off, rub to
pieces, grind to powder; मृदुना
सलिलेन खन्यमानान्यवघृष्यंति गिरेरपि स्थलानि
v. l. --Caus. To rub off, scratch.

1 Rubbing into.
--2
Grinding.
--3 Cleaning, rubbing off;
सलिलैः शुद्धिरेतेषां गोवालैश्चावघर्षणात्

अवघोटित a. Covered on all
sides, concealed.

To smell at; touch
